mechanism: Open on one compact identity activation, then alternate a stable graphic reset mode with short physical proof scenes. Each reset must re-establish the same subject through recurring silhouette, proportion or layout anchors, and each action block must answer one new capability question without changing identity. Reserve the last reset to absorb the peak action contour and resolve it into a held complete-subject lockup.

invariants.rule: Begin with one compact identity activation before showing the complete subject.
invariants.purpose: Creates a recognition cue that later resets can verify.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opening on the finished full-body card removes the identity question and weakens later confirmation.

invariants.rule: Establish one clearly different graphic reset mode that preserves subject silhouette and proportions.
invariants.purpose: Provides a stable comparison baseline between moving proof scenes.
invariants.ablation_failure: If the reset redesigns the subject or uses unrelated layouts, the sequence becomes a generic montage.

invariants.rule: Alternate reset and action so every action block proves one distinct capability while the next reset restores identity legibility.
invariants.purpose: Lets physical escalation accumulate without hiding subject drift.
invariants.ablation_failure: Uninterrupted action loses the verification rhythm; uninterrupted cards provide no capability proof.

invariants.rule: Raise physical demand in the later action proof while keeping the same defining silhouette and direction cues.
invariants.purpose: Creates escalation that remains auditable against the prior reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: A weaker or unrelated second action feels like repetition rather than progression.

invariants.rule: Carry the peak action contour into the final graphic state and hold a complete-subject lockup.
invariants.purpose: Converts motion into a readable terminal identity result.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending on motion blur, an isolated word or a cropped body denies final verification.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source brown-haired bespectacled young male character in a grey sleeveless hoodie and fingerless gloves
the source green glowing spectacle activation and fingertip-to-lens gesture
the source white rooftop or salt-flat action space with distant mountains and dark opponent
the source black, white, cyan and neon-yellow oversized editorial card system
the source circular brush rings, exact action choreography and final crouched pose
the source visible words RunningHUB, HERO and YOU

instantiations.concept: An original folding orbital rescue drone begins with one amber beacon iris activating in macro. A copper technical card locks its triangular silhouette, then a hangar test proves one magnetic grapple action. The card resets with the same dimensions before an exterior debris-lift proof; the lifted diagonal contour becomes a final slate-blue specification lockup showing the complete drone and secured cargo.

instantiations.concept: In tactile stop-motion, an original seed-sorting automaton starts when one ceramic eye shutter opens. A physical pegboard card records its squat outline, followed by one paper-seed pickup test. The pegboard resets before a steeper felt-ramp delivery; the ramp pose transfers into a final shadow-box catalog display that holds the complete machine and delivered seed tray.
